scalars.scalar_value: RECRUITMENT PERIOD ONE MONTH: Applicants will be screened after two weeks; and then on a weekly basis.  The position can be filled prior to the removal date.

Experience with routine laboratory tests performing PCV, TP, electrolytes, blood gases, glucose, osm, COP, BUN, creatinine, WBC, urinalysis, fibrinogen estimation, colostrum specific gravity, equine blood type-agglutination test diagnostic sampling, and understanding normal values.
Experience monitoring patient vital signs and administering PO, IV, SQ & IM medications.
Hours to be arranged. To include day shift, weekends, holidays, and on-call.

items.item_text: Must obtain Vet Assistant Controlled Substance Permit (VACSP) within 3 months of date of hire.
Current CA Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) license.
Experience monitoring patient vital signs and administering PO, IV, SQ & IM medications.

Experience with routine laboratory tests performing PCV, TP, electrolytes, blood gases, glucose, osm, COP, BUN, creatinine, WBC, urinalysis, fibrinogen estimation, colostrum specific gravity, equine blood type-agglutination test diagnostic sampling, and understanding normal values.
Extensive experience handling, restraining and working with horses (sick, healthy, sedated and fractious).
Experience with medications, drugs, and fluids commonly used in horses and performing mathematical calculations to calculate doses.
Experience with equine, husbandry, anatomy, behavior, and basic physiology to identify and describe abnormal physical signs and appearances.

Under general supervision of the Large Animal Equine Medicine Manager perform diagnostic exams and treatments according to the specific needs of each specialty service. Perform diagnostic exams and treatments according to the specific needs of each specialty service. Provide clinician medical record and prepare for exams, treatment procedures including necessary equipment. Obtain medical history from clients when students are unavailable. Coordinate with other service technicians when needed. Collect and submit on-line laboratory testing orders via VMACS for blood, urine, feces and all other bodily fluids. Perform point of service billing and ensure request forms are correct. Instruct students on basic diagnostic and nursing procedures, safe animal handling and all infectious disease control protocols. Maintain clean, neat and stocked exam rooms.
70% - Technical Support to LA Equine Medicine and Specialty Servies
20% - Nursing and Technical Duties for Other Large Animal Services
Oral and written communication and interpersonal skills to interact with a diverse group of people to include clients, veterinarians, students and staff.
Skill to recognize and handle difficult/unpleasant situations and/or individuals, and using problem solving skills.
